summary: Completed testing of Driver Logistics features - Iteration 22. Backend: 15/15 tests passed. Frontend: All UI components verified. Fixed 1 bug in geocode-trip endpoint.
seed_data_creation: Test trip 'trip-test-001' with 3 orders exists in balia section

driver_panel_login.details: Driver 'drivertest' can login and see assigned trips. Driver panel shows 'Кабинет водителя' header with driver name.

driver_panel_map_with_route.details: Map displays numbered markers (1, 2, 3) for orders with coordinates. Polyline route connects all markers. Footer shows 'Заказов: 3, С координатами: 3'.

driver_panel_orders_tab.details: Orders tab shows collapsed cards with customer name, address, phone number (+48...), and payment amount (PLN). Expanded cards show full details with Navigation and Delivery confirmation buttons.

driver_panel_start_trip.details: Start Trip button (В путь) changes trip status to 'in_transit' and all order statuses to 'delivering'. Test trip already in 'in_transit' status.

logistics_page_trip_list.details: Logistics page shows trips with section tabs (Теплицы, Купели, Сауны), inner tabs (Заказы, Рейсы), and map with filter options.

remove_order_from_trip_amocrm_feedback.details: POST /api/trips/{trip_id}/remove-orders returns detailed amoCRM sync result with amocrm_orders_count, amocrm_success_count, amocrm_error_count, amocrm_skipped_count, and amocrm_settings check.

push_notification_test_ui.details: Settings > Integracje > Уведомления tab shows Telegram-бот settings, test notification form with driver dropdown and message input, and Push-уведомления info.

geocode_trip_endpoint.details: POST /api/driver-panel/geocode-trip/{trip_id} endpoint works. Returns geocoded count and failed count. Fixed PyMongo collection bool check bug.

bugs_fixed.issue: PyMongo collection bool check error - 'if not collection:' raises NotImplementedError
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed to 'if collection is None:' on lines 200, 552, 633

context_for_next_testing_agent: All Driver Logistics features are working. Test file /app/tests/test_driver_logistics_features.py covers 15 test cases. amoCRM settings are not configured on test environment (domain/token empty), so amoCRM sync operations return 'skipped' status - this is expected behavior. Test data: trip-test-001 with 3 orders in balia section.
